cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Let's take 25% of {calc} as well. You're at {share}%. One ore means one bad price week can sink us. A second one means a swing in one is covered by the other. That's bills paid without panic.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: I want a second ore, {calc}, at 25% of London's supply. You hold {share}%. With two lines, one bad week doesn't take everything. Steady money is what lets me help people out.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Get {calc} up to 25%. You're on {share}% now. If all our income rides on one ore, other firms' price swings decide our week. Two ores and they only decide half of it.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: A second ore: 25% of {calc}. We're at {share}%. It's small now, which is the point. It's cheap to grow while nobody's watching, and it means we're not leaning on one price to pay the bills.
